title: Signal Drift
author: Demo Author
synopsis: The relay station at Kestrel-9 has one job: repeat what it hears, and nothing more. Junior operator Ivo Ren has been alone on the station for two hundred and six days when the signal arrives — a message in the station's own protocol, sent from the station's own transmitter, timestamped eleven hours from now. Protocol says log it and wait. Protocol has never been so obviously wrong.
